newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman prepares draft of new mining law.
newsitem.headline: Oman prepares draft of new mining law.

text.p: Oman has prepared a draft of a new mining law which will aim to encourage local and foreign private investors to participate in the Gulf Arab state's fledgling minerals sector.

"We have already submitted the draft mining law...The United Nations consultants will be in Oman at the end of the month to discuss it with the government," said Mohammed Kassim al-Yafai, minerals director general at the Ministry of Petroleum and Minerals.
He told Reuters that the new law, updating the 1974 mining law, would be aimed at "really creating the motive for the private sector to invest in mining".
He said the ministry was waiting for the new law to be passed before it awarded a Canadian and an Omani company licences to explore for copper and gold in some concession blocks.
